articles.summary: 17 August 2026, Shanghai – IHG One Rewards, the global loyalty programme of IHG Hotels & Resorts, today announced a partnership with Live Nation Asia across the Greater China region, bringing together hospitality with live entertainment. As part of this, new and existing IHG One Rewards members will have access to exclusive travel experiences in Hong Kong and Taiwan markets that pair stays at IHG Hotels & Resorts with select concerts, along with member-exclusive ticket giveaways and promotions across IHG One Rewards platforms and social media channels.
articles.title: IHG One Rewards Partners with Live Nation Asia across the Greater China region to Unlock Exclusive Concert Experiences for Travellers

articles.summary: Shanghai, 25 August 2026 — HUALUXE Hotels & Resorts, part of IHG Hotels & Resorts, has collaborated with SHANG XIA, a lifestyle brand rooted in Chinese culture, to bring cultural heritage and contemporary aesthetics into hospitality experiences. The collaboration will feature a co-branded bath amenities collection and a cultural experience series, combining HUALUXE’s Chinese-inspired hospitality with SHANG XIA’s expertise in contemporary design and craftsmanship.
articles.title: HUALUXE Hotels & Resorts Collaborates with SHANG XIA to Create Heritage-Inspired Guest Experiences

articles.summary: 6 August 2026, Shanghai – InterContinental Hotels & Resorts, a flagship brand within IHG Hotels & Resorts' Luxury & Lifestyle portfolio, today announced the launch of 'DOORS UNLOCKED' in Greater China to mark its 80th anniversary. The programme offers a series of exclusive, theatre-led cultural experiences in key cities, including Beijing and Shanghai.
